title: Use a photorealistic 3:4 full-body luxury fashion portrait prompt with detailed…
content: Use a photorealistic 3:4 full-body luxury fashion portrait prompt with detailed subject/wardrobe/pose/environment/lighting descriptors to generate the reference image for Seedance 2.5.
tips: Use a photorealistic 3:4 full-body luxury fashion portrait prompt with detailed subject/wardrobe/pose/environment/lighting descriptors to generate the reference image for Seedance 2.5.

en.content: Use a photorealistic 3:4 full-body luxury fashion portrait prompt with detailed subject, wardrobe, pose, environment, and lighting descriptors to generate the reference image for Seedance 2.5.

es.content: Usa un prompt de retrato de moda de lujo, fotorrealista y de cuerpo entero en formato 3:4, con descriptores detallados del sujeto, el vestuario, la pose, el entorno y la iluminación para generar la imagen de referencia para Seedance 2.5.

fr.content: Utilisez un prompt de portrait de mode de luxe photoréaliste en plein corps au format 3:4, avec des descriptions détaillées du sujet, de la tenue, de la pose, de l’environnement et de l’éclairage, afin de générer l’image de référence pour Seedance 2.5.

ja.content: Seedance 2.5 の参照画像を生成するために、被写体・衣装・ポーズ・環境・ライティングの詳細な記述を含む、フォトリアルな 3:4 の全身ラグジュアリーファッションポートレートの prompt を使用してください。

ko.content: Seedance 2.5용 레퍼런스 이미지를 생성하기 위해, 피사체/의상/포즈/환경/조명에 대한 세부 묘사가 포함된 포토리얼리스틱 3:4 전신 럭셔리 패션 포트레이트 프롬프트를 사용하세요.

pt.content: Use um prompt de retrato de moda de luxo em corpo inteiro, fotorealista, no formato 3:4, com descrições detalhadas de sujeito/vestuário/pose/ambiente/iluminação para gerar a imagem de referência para o Seedance 2.5.
